title: Speculation that Kirkpatrick was read into the legacy program
summary: Kurt McConnell tells of Speculation that Kirkpatrick was read into the legacy program, about 2022-2023 at AARO, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and you know there's speculation that he was uh read into the legacy program and

plain: Sean Kirkpatrick was the first head of AARO, a Pentagon office set up around 2022 to look into unexplained objects in the sky. A former US Senate staffer, Kurt McConnell, says on a podcast that some people suspect Kirkpatrick was "read into", meaning secretly briefed on, a so-called legacy program, a hidden effort that people claim holds craft that were not made by humans. If true, the official in charge of investigating would have known more than he said.
